objective: Repair the review findings on commits ecea23f and 41754dd and add the assignment reports command the new root text relies on.
scope: Security finding (blocking): packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts fetchRemoteBranch (about :415-424, called :471) can prompt or hang: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 does not stop ssh host-key or passphrase prompts, SSH_ASKPASS/GIT_ASKPASS or credential helpers, it has no timeout and runs under worktree.lock, and SessionStart can reach it through ifPresent plus keepsState.

Evidence matching (packages/runtime/src/cli/report.ts acceptanceFrom): real reports failed to match because a criterion label equal to an evidence label (Autocompact / autocompact, Scope / scope) is discarded as ambiguous, hyphens differ from spaces (agent-effort vs Agent effort), and keys carry list markers or bold ('- Token totals:', '**Root context**:').

New command `holyagent assignment reports <journal.jsonl>`: a Workflow run's journal has lines {type:'started', key, agentId, label} and {type:'result', key, agentId, result}; the root labels each agent() with its Assignment id.
Code-review non-blocking items: no test covers writeBrief failing (assignment.ts:201); the dispatch prompt says 'your full task' twice.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (Effect, Schema at the journal boundary with onExcessProperty handled for the extra fields the journal may carry, JSDoc, Bun Shell or Bun APIs).

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. Run bun test, bun check, bun lint and bun fmt --check (mise may be missing), then rebuild the generated plugin (bun scripts/build.ts or the build task mise.toml names) so the sync test passes. When done, stop and report under 600 words with the changed paths and a diff file under /tmp/holyagent-review/; name unrequested ideas instead of building them.

criteria.text: Fetch safety: the state fetch runs with ssh BatchMode and a connect timeout (unless the user set GIT_SSH_COMMAND), without askpass programs or interactive credential helpers, under a hard timeout of at most 10 seconds, and never from a hook, so SessionStart makes no network call; a test covers the timeout or the non-interactive environment

Matching: a criterion label equal to an evidence label supports both; hyphens and underscores match spaces; a leading list marker or bold markers around the key are ignored; tests cover each with lines taken from real reports

Reports command: assignment reports <journal> writes each result to a file named by its label under the briefs' sibling folder (for example <git common dir>/holyagent/reports/<id>.md), prints one row per result with id, path and word count, lists labels that are not Assignment ids, refuses a malformed journal with a tagged error, and appears in holyagent help; tests cover it
Brief: the dispatch prompt names the brief path once without repeating itself, the agent-launch hook still records it, and a test covers a brief write failure leaving the Assignment Ready
Docs: docs/pi/claude-parity.md no longer describes the root reading screenshots to accept visual work
Gates: bun test, bun check, bun lint and bun fmt --check pass and the generated plugin matches a fresh build
Scope: only the ownership paths change
